testcase.name: having been asked before, turning it on asks for nothing
turning it off asks for nothing more
with the permission already granted it is not asked for
Continue without files saves the backup and says how many photos were left out
turning scheduled backups on asks for the notification permission
turning it on with no folder asks for nothing
Back up now offers the default file name, writes the backup where the user chose, and says Backup saved
Replace restores the chosen file in Replace mode and shows Restore complete
Cancel on the unreadable photos prompt deletes the file this run created
Cancel on the prompt restores nothing and closes it
How often changes the scheduled frequency
Choose folder opens the folder picker, and with a folder chosen the switch turns on and schedules the backup
the Automatic backup switch is off, and turning it on with no folder leaves it off and says why
Settings has a Backup section with exactly the approved labels
while a track is recording, Restore from backup says so and opens no picker
a file that already has contents is asked about before anything is written, with the owner's words
declining the permission does not stop the schedule
turning it on, off and on again asks for the notification permission once
a failed write shows the owner's message with Try again and Cancel, and Try again opens the Save picker again
Merge restores the chosen file in Merge mode and shows Restore complete
Restore from backup opens the file picker, then asks with the approved title, body and buttons
turning the automatic backup on leaves Weekly selected, the default the owner chose
Replace on that question writes the backup, and Cancel writes nothing
unreadable photos pause the backup with the owner's words and three buttons
a backup whose file cannot be opened shows Couldn't save the backup and not Backup saved
a restore that fails shows Couldn't restore that backup
a notice kept for launch is shown once, in the app, in the approved words
